definition.proposition: Looped LMs at scale also peak at the trained loop count and degrade beyond it: Ouro 1.4B/2.6B (7.7T tokens, trained T=4) show "moderate degradation" at T=5–8 (2.6B-Thinking OlympiadBench 76.4 at T=4 → 39.3 at T=8), so our C7 shape need not be a small-scale artifact
